subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: MWCC GC 1.2.5, -O4,p. PART 1 (v1, unchanged and still the screen). The target's recurring `b<cond> <next+4>` + unconditional `b <exit>` pair (fndiff --ops reports `target-only: +1 b +1 bge/ble/bne  ours-only: -1 blt/bgt/beq`) is NOT a peephole artifact and is NOT source-unreachable: our own objects emit it at 503 sites across 257 objects (census at ca4074cb1; retail carries 563). What decides the shape is WHAT THE THEN-BLOCK IS. A then-block that leaves the function -- `return;` / `return <value>;` -- is lowered as branch-over-one plus an unconditional branch and is never folded. A then-block that is a `goto <label>` IS folded to a single inverted conditional, and no spelling of the goto escapes it. FOLDS (all NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL or worse): `if (c) goto A; goto B;` (InitTexMods, DoAudioTallySFX, PlaceItem, ControllerMessageBox), `if (c) goto A; else goto B;`, an if/else diamond with an EMPTY then-arm, and `do { if (c) break; ... } while (0)`. DOES NOT FOLD (byte-exact wins): `if (A || B) { return; }` closed DoAudioTallySFX (real 5 -> 0), InitTexMods (real 2 -> 0) and DoPolyInst (real 4 -> 0) in one probe each. Matched-code exemplars: zlib `uncompress`, dolphin/card `__CARDSeek`, atree `AtreeFindNodeIdx`, gcontrolpads `G3DGetControlPadAnalogStick`. DO NOT reach for `#pragma peephole off`: on InitTexMods it regressed real 2 -> 18 and STILL emitted the fused `blt`. Population at ca4074cb1 was 51 functions, 47 after run 44's closures. PART 2 (run 45, NEW -- the general form of v1's search-loop corollary). v1's corollary was scoped to 'a SEARCH LOOP whose result is an index'. The general rule: when the target carries the unfused pair at a site whose then-block is NOT a return -- an assignment, an if-body, a plain skip -- the pair is an INLINED HELPER'S RETURN JOIN, and the cure is to lift that region into a `static inline` helper with `return` exits, leaving the outer function a single `return <call>` or a single assignment from it. Three byte-exact closures run 45, each on the FIRST probe of the lift, on functions where seven recorded prior probes of goto/switch/ternary/`||`/`&&` spellings had all failed: FindWORLDOBJ real 17 -> 0 (attempt.NM_findworldobj-closes-exact-as-an-inlined-helper-return-join.20260903.v1), AudioEnterNextStage real 4 -> 0 (attempt.NM_audioenternextstage-closes-exact-as-an-inlined-single-exit-zero-helper.20260903.v1), CritterMoveSetup real 7 -> 0 (attempt.NM_crittermovesetup-inline-helper-plus-dead-local-removal-closes-exact.20260903.v1). FindWORLDOBJ is the sharpest case: its run-44 record had proved the branch half and the return join were a COMPENSATING PAIR -- writing `return node;` directly won the branch and lost the single `mr r3,r31` -- and under the lift both come for free, because the pair is the INLINE's return lowering while the `mr` is the outer function's own return. HOW TO RECOGNISE IT before spending a probe, in the aligned view: the pair's unconditional `b` lands on a block that ASSIGNS a value and falls through to the consumer (`li rN,0`, `mr rN,rM`, `lha rN,<disp>(rB)`), and other exits of the same region branch to that same block. That block IS the inline-return join and rN is the inline's result register. Confirming evidence is often in the same object: FindWorldObject, already at real 0, contains a second INLINED copy of FindWORLDOBJ's walk and carries the identical unfused pair at its inline-return site (+0x64 `bne ->6c` / `b ->cc`). PART 3, the three cost clauses, each measured both ways. (a) TAIL-MERGE: the number of exits returning the SAME value decides whether MWCC merges them. AudioEnterNextStage measured both directions on one function -- a helper with TWO early `return 0;` sites emitted TWO zero materialisations and lost count parity (real 15, T50/O51, `O[7:10]@1c-28=['bge','li','b']` against `T[7:8]@1c-20=['blt']`), while the same helper with ONE trailing `return 0;` emitted the target's single shared `li r3,0` and closed exact. (b) `static inline`, NOT bare `static`: a bare `static` helper produced byte-exact .text AND a standalone emitted body whose exception record cost 144 bytes of matched Data image-wide (ninja PROGRESS Data 177572 -> 177428; Game Code Data 66.06% -> 65.92%) -- invisible to real, --ops, regnorm, the multiset and fuzzy, every one of which scored that keep as a clean win. `static inline` suppresses the standalone body and Data returns to 177572. (c) The lift ORPHANS the outer function's locals and MWCC keeps nominal frame space for them: CritterMoveSetup sat at multiset-IDENTICAL 77/77 with five IMMEDIATE rows that were ALL frame words (frame 32 vs 48) until `void *node; void *candidate; s32 nodeIndex;` were deleted, per claim.law.dead-nominal-local-area-tracks-declaration-count.20260831.v1. Delete them in the same edit. WHEN IT DOES NOT PAY, so this is not read as unconditional: CritterAnimate's lift closed its pair exactly (the aligned rows at +0x60/+0x64 became `=`) but the inline's result landed in r3 and cost an `addi r5,r3,0` the target does not have, taking real 38 -> 108 and FRESH fuzzy 98.86% -> 98.7766%; two further spellings (chained `nextIndex = candidate = helper(c)`, hoisting the helper's local) were both NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, so the result-register class is not reachable by declaration spelling. Before lifting, check in the aligned view that the target's join register is the destination VARIABLE's register and not the ABI return register.
